item.description: Brandon Vermont is applying for a grant to plan housing and transportation projects. The Better Connections grant will fund community engagement and planning for future developments. The town will provide a ten percent match from economic development funds.
Authorities are looking for a vehicle involved in a crash near West Rutland Town Hall. The crash damaged signage on the town hall's front lawn.

The Otter Valley School Board in Brandon is facing budget challenges for fiscal year twenty-twenty-eight. They approved a retirement buyout program for eligible teachers and administrators. The board will discuss bus stop clustering and preschool programs at their next meeting on November seventeenth.

Lincoln Vermont had a New York City parking ticket rescinded. The ticket was for a five-ton wheel-loader that never left the Lincoln garage. New York City officials admitted the error and canceled the fine.
